create_crossformer_model: create a CrossFormer model for image classification with configurable dimensions, depths, and window sizes
build_cross_embed_layer: build a CrossEmbedLayer that applies multi-scale convolutions with different kernel sizes to an input tensor
run_crossformer_forward: run a forward pass on a CrossFormer model with an input image tensor to produce classification logits
configure_local_global_attention: configure a Transformer with both short-range local and long-range global attention using dynamic positional bias
test_crossformer_classification: test the CrossFormer model on image classification with custom num_classes, channels, and dropout settings
